en_US.title: Acoustic Relay Spine Assembly
en_US.scanner: Relay spine partial. The capsule can ping through water, not speak cleanly through orbit.
en_US.terminal: ASCENT RELAY: rebuild a low-band acoustic spine before any recovery window. High-gain mast lost. Emergency buoy unreliable. Do not promise rescue without route proof.
en_US.audio: If Black Keel hears this, it hears a pressure code, not a voice.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The first escape component is not a radio miracle. It is a physical acoustic relay chain: pinger float, ceramic ribs, cable skin and timing discipline.
en_US.external_site: HECTON-8 escape is engineering, not a cutscene. The player must rebuild a route for sound before asking orbit to believe the signal.
en_US.field_note: Place on broken mast or pinger-line evidence near capsule/P-63 routes.

ru_RU.title: Сборка акустического релейного хребта
ru_RU.scanner: Неполный релейный хребет. Капсула может стучать через воду, но не говорить с орбитой чистым каналом.
ru_RU.terminal: ASCENT RELAY: сначала восстановить низкочастотный акустический хребет. High-gain mast lost. Emergency buoy unreliable. Rescue без route proof запрещен.
ru_RU.audio: Если Black Keel это услышит, он услышит код давления, а не голос.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Первый компонент побега не радиочудо. Это физическая цепь акустической связи: pinger float, ceramic ribs, cable skin и точное окно.
ru_RU.external_site: Побег с HECTON-8 строится как инженерная задача. Игрок сначала чинит путь для звука, и только потом просит орбиту поверить сигналу.
ru_RU.field_note: Ставить на сломанную мачту, pinger-line или капсульный/P-63 маршрут.

en_US.title: Pressure Seal Clamp Ring Assembly
en_US.scanner: Clamp ring scar. The capsule's ascent sleeve is not missing; it was spent during impact survival.
en_US.terminal: SEAL CERT: shallow patch holds a room. It does not hold ascent. Certified rings require pressure glass seat, shell-sealant map, and a Deep Reach clamp profile.
en_US.audio: The useful seal is the one Atlas grew wrong. That is the problem.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Pressure seals explain why the player must go deeper: safe-room repair is not ascent repair, and Atlas bio-sealant can preserve a module while blocking clean separation.
en_US.external_site: The damaged capsule cannot simply lift off. Its ascent seal chain needs deep-rated rings, pressure glass and a repair decision that may involve Atlas-grown material.
en_US.field_note: Use where repair ecology and mechanical seal evidence overlap.

ru_RU.title: Сборка прижимного кольца герметизации
ru_RU.scanner: След clamp ring. Ascent sleeve не исчез; его потратили, чтобы капсула пережила удар.
ru_RU.terminal: SEAL CERT: shallow patch держит комнату. Он не держит ascent. Нужны pressure glass seat, shell-sealant map и Deep Reach clamp profile.
ru_RU.audio: Полезный уплотнитель здесь тот, который Atlas вырастил неправильно. В этом и проблема.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Герметизация объясняет, почему игрок идет глубже: ремонт убежища не равен ремонту взлета, а био-герметик Atlas может спасти модуль и заблокировать отделение.
ru_RU.external_site: Поврежденная капсула не может просто улететь. Ей нужны глубоководные кольца, pressure glass и решение, использовать ли материал, выращенный Atlas.
ru_RU.field_note: Ставить там, где repair ecology пересекается с механикой seal evidence.

en_US.title: Guidance Timing Core Assembly
en_US.scanner: Timing core blank. Aegir geometry decides whether ascent is recovery, capture, or silence.
en_US.terminal: GUIDANCE CORE: align capsule clock to Aegir window, Black Keel receiver, moon relay shutter, and storm plume drift. Late packets become evidence loss.
en_US.audio: There is no up. There is a window, a receiver, and a lie in the queue.
en_US.in_game_wiki: A working ascent needs a guidance timing core that understands Aegir's moon geometry, blackout intervals and carrier recovery lanes.
en_US.external_site: HECTON-8 keeps spaceflight hard-sci-fi: orbital timing, relay shadows and damaged beacons turn extraction into a route problem.
en_US.field_note: Bind to orbital-window charts, beacon fragments and guidance gimbal wreckage.

ru_RU.title: Сборка ядра наведения и тайминга
ru_RU.scanner: Пустой timing core. Геометрия Aegir решает, будет ли ascent спасением, захватом или тишиной.

en_US.title: Ascent Energy Charge Assembly
en_US.scanner: Energy cradle scored by pressure pulse. Cheap charge equals dead capsule.
en_US.terminal: ASCENT CHARGE: vent-forged heat cell, pressure-history insulator, custody stamp. Raw fuel is rejected. Uncertified blue debt fractures under launch impulse.
en_US.audio: Every gram here is either escape, evidence, or money. You do not get all three.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The ascent charge turns resources into a moral and mechanical trade: deep pressure materials can lift the player, preserve evidence, or become payout.
en_US.external_site: Resource design ties directly into narrative: blue debt and vent-forged hardware are not loot sparkle; they decide escape, custody and compromise.
en_US.field_note: The vent-forge route turns every charge decision into a split between escape reliability, evidence value, and blue-debt payout.

en_US.title: Quarantine Legal Handshake Assembly
en_US.scanner: Handshake socket. The capsule can be mechanically ready and still legally captured.
en_US.terminal: RECOVERY HANDSHAKE: receiver key required. Keelmark accepts mass and lien. Recovery Compliance accepts coordinates. Public ledger accepts proof with delay.
en_US.audio: The last part is not metal. It is who gets to call you recovered.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The final escape component is legal and informational: quarantine status, receiver identity, payload custody and evidence state decide the ending branch.
en_US.external_site: HECTON-8's extraction fantasy is deliberately dirty. Mechanical ascent can still become corporate custody, public truth or an unresolved quarantine.
en_US.field_note: Exit readiness is mechanical, legal, and evidentiary at once; the chosen receiver defines what recovery means.
